description: Named before/after comparison scenes for v0.18's visual work. tools/capture_scenes.py turns each into voxelcraft --screenshot runs; scripts/boat-capture.sh runs them on Boat with a software GPU. Appearance only, never performance.

scenes.name: stone-ore-wall
scenes.description: A 33 x 19 wall of stone over a deepslate band, with every ore and andesite/tuff patches scattered, 11.5 blocks away at noon: tiling and ore contrast

scenes.name: cave-ceiling
scenes.description: Inside a closed 21 x 21 stone room with a patchy ceiling 6 blocks up, lit only by five torches, looking up at the ceiling: cave stone tiling and warm torchlight

scenes.name: grass-hillside
scenes.description: A 33-wide hillside of grass blocks stepping up one block every two rows, dirt showing in each step, with grass and flowers, from above at noon: grass top, side and dirt tiling

scenes.name: forest
scenes.description: Eight oak, birch and spruce trees (logs and leaves) on a grass floor, from a little above the canopy edge at noon: leaf and bark patterns

scenes.name: sand-dunes
scenes.description: Low sand mounds over sandstone with cactus and dead bushes, from above at noon: sand tiling and contrast

scenes.name: block-palette
scenes.description: Thirty-two common natural and wood blocks as 2 x 2 tiles in an 8 x 4 grid, face on at noon: side-by-side palette and contrast

scenes.name: material-items
scenes.description: Material blocks as hotbar icons (stone held in first person) and as nine dropped items fanned out on a grass and stone floor at noon: icon, held and dropped material art

scenes.name: material-families
scenes.description: Thirty-two more natural, polished and stripped blocks (sandstones, dirts, clay, bedrock, polished stones, cobbled deepslate, three leaves, pale oak and eight stripped logs) as 2 x 2 x 2 cubes in four rising rows, from above at noon: tops and sides of the second-round materials

scenes.name: material-masonry
scenes.description: Thirty-two bricks, tiles, chiseled and cut stones, mud and azalea leaves as 2 x 2 x 2 cubes in four rising rows, from above at noon: the third round's masonry

scenes.name: material-terracotta
scenes.description: Plain and the sixteen coloured terracottas, a block of stripped bamboo and three glazed terracottas (unchanged, for comparison) as 2 x 2 x 2 cubes in rising rows, from above at noon

scenes.name: material-copper
scenes.description: The copper block, cut, chiseled, grate and bulb at each oxidation stage, then the quartz blocks, as 2 x 2 x 2 cubes in rising rows from above at noon

scenes.name: material-colours
scenes.description: The sixteen concretes with their powders resting on them, the sixteen wools behind, and ten ore and raw-ore blocks at the back, from above at noon: dyed surfaces and ore blocks

scenes.name: material-nether
scenes.description: The Nether's natural blocks and the block of netherite as 2 x 2 x 2 cubes in rising rows from above at noon

scenes.name: material-end
scenes.description: End stone, obsidian, crying obsidian, purpur, end stone bricks and amethyst as 2 x 2 x 2 cubes from above at noon

scenes.name: material-fixtures
scenes.description: Copper bars, chains, lanterns, trapdoors and lightning rods at each oxidation stage, then the iron bars, chain, lanterns and trapdoor, as 2 x 2 x 2 groups in rising rows from above at noon

scenes.name: material-nether-wood-ice
scenes.description: Crimson and warped stems, stripped stems, hyphae and planks, bone block, then ice, blue ice, snow, powder snow and frosted ice, as 2 x 2 x 2 cubes from above at noon

scenes.name: material-workstations
scenes.description: Fifteen workstations and bookshelves as 2 x 2 x 2 groups in rising rows from above at noon

scenes.name: mobs-uneven-ground
scenes.description: Nine mobs and a fan of dropped items on grass with one- and two-block bumps, a moment after spawning, at sunrise (time 0.0, held: below the undead sunburn threshold, as in the entities benchmark): silhouettes, faces and ground contact

scenes.name: mobs-night
scenes.description: The same ground and mobs at midnight: entity lighting and visibility at night

scenes.name: hud-survival
scenes.description: The survival HUD: hotbar, hearts, hunger, armor, experience and two status effects, no screen open

scenes.name: inventory
scenes.description: The survival inventory with a filled hotbar and main inventory

scenes.name: recipe-book
scenes.description: The survival inventory with the recipe book open beside it

scenes.name: crafting-table
scenes.description: A crafting table opened with --open-block, with the recipe book open

scenes.name: furnace
scenes.description: A furnace opened with --open-block

scenes.name: creative-search
scenes.description: The creative inventory on the Search tab (today: the one creative palette)

scenes.name: creative-building-blocks
scenes.description: The creative inventory on the Building Blocks tab (today the palette, until v0.18 track 4 adds the tabs)

scenes.name: pause-menu
scenes.description: The pause menu over the world

scenes.name: video-settings
scenes.description: Options > Video Settings

scenes.name: death-screen
scenes.description: The survival death screen (--health 0)

scenes.name: hardcore-death
scenes.description: Dying in a Hardcore world (--hardcore --health 0); v0.18 track 2 brings Java's Hardcore death screen

scenes.name: sign-text
scenes.description: Three oak signs 2.8 blocks away at noon, the eye level with their text: accented Latin-1 and Latin Extended-A, ASCII, and lines at and past the 90-pixel width (v0.18 track 1 font)
args: 1,159,0,WWWWWWWWWWWWWWW|iiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii|Ŋ ő ŀ ſ ĳ ŉ ŧ|¿Qué? ¡Sí! «»

scenes.name: accessibility-settings
scenes.description: Accessibility Settings, with Java's text options (Text Background, Text Background Opacity, Closed Captions)

scenes.name: title-screen
scenes.description: The title screen

scenes.name: world-list
scenes.description: Select World with four saved worlds (survival, creative, hardcore and a pre-0.6 world), dated an hour apart

scenes.name: world-list-empty
scenes.description: Select World with no saved worlds

scenes.name: create-world
scenes.description: Create New World

scenes.name: world-list-icons
scenes.description: Select World with the same four saves, three with the icon the game takes on a first visit from their spawn (v0.18 track 7); the pre-0.6 world keeps the default icon

scenes.name: day
scenes.description: Seeded landscape from above at noon (the development guide's landscape pose)

scenes.name: dusk
scenes.description: The same landscape at sunset, facing west

scenes.name: night
scenes.description: The same landscape at midnight

scenes.name: rain
scenes.description: The same landscape in rain at noon

scenes.name: thunder
scenes.description: The same landscape in a thunderstorm at noon

scenes.name: underwater
scenes.description: Inside a 17 x 17 x 9 glass tank of water over sand and seagrass, at noon: underwater fog and visibility

scenes.name: nether
scenes.description: The Nether from y 70 at the origin, facing north-east

scenes.name: end
scenes.description: The End's main island from 60 blocks east, facing its centre

scenes.name: nether-arrival
scenes.description: The Nether where its portal arrives for the seed (no pose: the arrival's own camera), so the view is open Nether air: fog distance and biome haze (v0.18 track 8; the nether scene faces a fortress wall)

scenes.name: cave-ceiling-night
scenes.description: The torch-lit stone room of cave-ceiling at midnight, so the five torches light it rather than the sky above the build: warm torchlight, falloff and contact shading (v0.18 track 8)

scenes.name: underwater-ocean
scenes.description: Eleven blocks under the deep ocean west of the seed's ocean monument (24, 48, 712), facing it: the sea floor, the monument and open water at ordinary underwater distances (v0.18 track 8; the underwater tank floats in the air and its sand floor falls away, so its view is mostly empty fog)

scenes.name: mobs-still-farm
scenes.description: Close-up of a chicken, pig, cow, sheep and wolf at noon, pinned with --still-mobs (each mob lands, then holds still facing the camera), with dropped items in front and one- and two-block steps under the sheep and wolf: faces, markings and ground shadows on uneven terrain

scenes.name: mobs-still-hostile
scenes.description: Close-up of a villager, zombie, skeleton, creeper, enderman and spider at noon, pinned with --still-mobs (landed mobs hold still facing the camera and don't burn), on flat grass with a one-block step: faces, markings, material contrast and ground shadows

scenes.name: mobs-still-village-nether
scenes.description: Pinned close-up (v0.18 Track 6 round 2): iron golem, witch, pillager, vindicator, evoker, piglin, zombified piglin, hoglin and blaze at noon, each holding still facing the camera

scenes.name: mobs-still-animals
scenes.description: Pinned close-up (v0.18 Track 6 round 2): horse, llama, goat, fox, cat, rabbit, panda and polar bear at noon, facing the camera

scenes.name: mobs-still-small
scenes.description: Pinned close-up (v0.18 Track 6 round 2): slime, magma cube, frog, axolotl, turtle, bee, parrot, silverfish, endermite and bat at noon (fliers hold still after ten ticks)

scenes.name: mobs-still-large
scenes.description: Pinned close-up (v0.18 Track 6 round 2): camel, sniffer, warden, ravager and squid at noon, facing the camera

scenes.name: mobs-still-variants
scenes.description: Pinned close-up (v0.18 Track 6 round 3): two rows of mobs whose look varies by spawn roll (cats, pandas, rabbits, axolotls, parrots, foxes, frogs), at noon, facing the camera

scenes.name: mobs-still-rest
scenes.description: Pinned close-up (v0.18 Track 6 round 4): endermite, silverfish, allay, shulker, nautilus, copper golem, creaking, snow golem, sulfur cube and tadpole at noon, facing the camera

scenes.name: mobs-still-big
scenes.description: Pinned scene (v0.18 Track 6 round 4): ghast, Wither and elder guardian behind, zoglin, skeleton horse, zombie horse, mooshroom, parched and camel husk in front, at noon, facing the camera

scenes.name: material-wood-doors
scenes.description: v1.0 Track 10: the thirteen wooden doors (oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, pale oak, bamboo, crimson, warped, poplar), both halves, closed, in a row on a stone floor in front of a calcite wall, face on at noon

scenes.name: material-wood-trapdoors-chests
scenes.description: v1.0 Track 10: the thirteen wooden trapdoors (closed) as 2 x 2 groups, then a chest, a trapped chest and a double of each facing the camera, from above at noon

scenes.name: material-farm-blocks
scenes.description: v1.0 Track 10: dirt path beside grass, hay bales upright and on their sides, TNT and the three anvils as 2 x 2 groups, then four bells on stone and single anvils and TNT, from above at noon

scenes.name: material-plants
scenes.description: v1.0 Track 10: four rows of plants on grass: the small flowers; the other flowers, mushrooms, fungi and grasses; the saplings and bushes; the tall flowers and grasses, sugar cane, a ripe berry bush and the Nether roots, from above at noon; random ticks off, so nothing grows during the capture

scenes.name: material-crops
scenes.description: v1.0 Track 10: wheat, carrots and potatoes at each age on farmland; beetroots, torchflower and pitcher crops, melon stems and attached stems; nether wart on soul sand, sweet berry bushes, then nether sprouts, twisting vines, small dripleaf and the hanging plants set on the ground to show their faces, from above at noon; random ticks off, so nothing grows during the capture

scenes.name: material-ground-plants
scenes.description: v1.0 Track 10b: the flat ground plants on grass (lily pads on a pool, a patch of pink petals, wildflowers and leaf litter with one to four segments), then bamboo stalks of three heights with their leaves, a bamboo shoot, glow lichen on the ground, a torchflower beside the potted torchflower, and an ender chest beside a chest, from above at noon; random ticks off

scenes.name: material-hanging-plants
scenes.description: v1.0 Track 10b: under a stone overhang at noon, looking a little up: cave vines with and without glow berries, a spore blossom, hanging roots, pale hanging moss and weeping vines hanging from the ceiling; a curtain of vines and patches of glow lichen on the back wall, lichen on the ceiling and floor, and twisting vines climbing from the floor; random ticks off

scenes.name: material-water-plants
scenes.description: v1.0 Track 10b: inside a glass tank of water over sand at noon, looking down at the corals: the five coral blocks alive (left) and dead (right), each with its coral on top, its wall fan on the front face and its fan on the sand behind; one to four sea pickles, seagrass, tall seagrass and kelp; random ticks off

scenes.name: material-amethyst-bamboo
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7: amethyst buds (small, medium, large) and the cluster standing on budding amethyst, hanging from an amethyst ledge and on its wall; bamboo bare and with small and large leaves on posts one to three blocks tall; the potted bamboo beside a potted fern, from in front at noon; random ticks off

scenes.name: portals
scenes.description: Two lit Nether portals on a stone floor in the sky at noon, one along X and one along Z, seen at an angle: the thin plane along each axis, its animated texture and the obsidian frame around it (v1.0 gap Track 5c)

scenes.name: portal-close
scenes.description: The portal along X from three blocks away at an angle: the plane 4/16 thick through the middle of the frame's cells (v1.0 gap Track 5c)

scenes.name: night-vision-night
scenes.description: The night landscape with Night Vision: lightmap.fsh's max(ambient, #999999) added before sky and block light (v1.0 gap Track 5c)

scenes.name: night-vision-cave
scenes.description: The torch-lit stone room at midnight with Night Vision (v1.0 gap Track 5c)

scenes.name: night-vision-nether
scenes.description: The Nether arrival view with Night Vision, against the Nether's own ambient colour (v1.0 gap Track 5c)

scenes.name: mobs-still-held-hands
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7b: humanoids holding their weapons at noon, pinned with --still-mobs and facing the camera, so each holds it in its own right hand (the viewer's left): zombie with an iron sword, husk with an iron shovel, drowned with a trident, skeleton with its bow, stray with an iron sword, pillager with its crossbow, piglin, zombified piglin and wither skeleton with their own weapons

scenes.name: mobs-still-babies
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7b: babies at noon, pinned with --still-mobs and facing the camera; front row chicken, pig, cow, sheep, wolf, cat, fox and rabbit, back row villager, zombie, piglin, hoglin, horse, llama, panda and polar bear

scenes.name: mobs-still-babies-all
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7c: a baby of every kind Java 26.3 draws with a baby model of its own, at noon, pinned with --still-mobs and facing the camera; rows front to back: chicken, pig, cow, mooshroom, sheep, wolf, cat, ocelot, fox, rabbit, armadillo; villager, zombie, husk, drowned, zombie villager, piglin, zombified piglin, hoglin, zoglin, strider, bee; horse, donkey, mule, skeleton and zombie horse, llama, trader llama, camel; panda, polar bear, sniffer, goat, the ghastling and turtle, then in the pool dolphin, squid, glow squid, axolotl and nautilus

scenes.name: mobs-still-joints
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7c: the adults whose models gained Java's joints, at noon, pinned with --still-mobs: rabbit, bat, parrot, horse, donkey and a phantom on land and in the air, then in the pool a guardian, an elder guardian and a pufferfish

scenes.name: mobs-still-model-details
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7d: from above at noon, pinned with --still-mobs and facing the camera: front row an adult nautilus, a zombie nautilus and a baby nautilus (shell first, the body and mouth trailing behind); back row a llama cria, a camel calf, an armadillo pup, a snifflet, two horse foals (their markings random) and a trader llama cria in its blanket

scenes.name: mobs-nautilus-swim
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7d: seen from inside a glass-roofed stone tank at noon, three nautiluses and two zombie nautiluses swimming freely (not pinned, so they turn their sides to the camera; their places vary from run to run)

scenes.name: burning-projectiles
scenes.description: Two burning arrows and a burning trident stuck in a stone floor in the sky at noon, a plain arrow beside them, from two blocks away: Java's flame (`FlameFeatureRenderer`: two camera-facing fire quads over each 0.5 by 0.5 box) on the burning ones (v1.0 gap Track 8c)

scenes.name: unlit-projectiles
scenes.description: The burning-projectiles scene with none of them burning, as every burning arrow and trident was drawn before v1.0 gap Track 8c

scenes.name: mobs-still-villager-types
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7e: villager type outfits at noon, pinned with --still-mobs and facing the camera; desert, jungle, plains, savanna, snow, swamp and taiga from right to left on screen; rows front to back: jobless adult villagers, zombie villagers, then a villager child and a zombie villager cub of each type side by side

scenes.name: mobs-still-villager-jobs
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7e: villager layers at noon, pinned with --still-mobs and facing the camera; front row: a desert farmer and butcher (their hats hide the desert wrap), a desert zombie villager butcher (its wrap shows), a snow librarian, jungle fisherman, savanna fletcher and taiga shepherd; back row: a plains nitwit (no badge), a swamp cleric, a plains mason holding up an emerald, a zombie villager in iron armor, a snow zombie armorer, a wandering trader and an adult fox

scenes.name: mobs-still-villager-professions
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7f: every profession on plains villagers at noon, pinned with --still-mobs and facing the camera; front row left to right on screen right to left: armorer (stone badge), butcher, cartographer, cleric, farmer, fisherman, fletcher; back row: leatherworker, librarian, mason, shepherd, toolsmith, weaponsmith, nitwit (no badge); levels cycle 1 to 5 along each row

scenes.name: mobs-still-zombie-villager-professions
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7f: the same professions and rows as mobs-still-villager-professions on snow zombie villagers (their clothes rotted), at noon, pinned with --still-mobs

scenes.name: mobs-still-villager-faces
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7f: close-up at noon, pinned with --still-mobs: front row (on screen right to left) a taiga armorer in its welding mask, a plains cartographer with its monocle, a desert weaponsmith with its eyepatch, a swamp cleric; back row a jungle leatherworker and a savanna toolsmith

scenes.name: mobs-still-fox-held
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7f: foxes holding items in their mouths (FoxHeldItemLayer) at noon, pinned with --still-mobs, on screen right to left: an adult fox with an emerald, a fox kit with a feather, an adult fox with wheat

scenes.name: mobs-still-villagers-plain
scenes.description: v1.0 gap Track 7e before/after: at noon, pinned with --still-mobs and facing the camera; front row a villager, a villager holding an emerald, a zombie villager, one in iron armor and a wandering trader; back row a villager child, a zombie villager cub, an adult fox and a fox kit (types from the capture world's biome)

scenes.name: burning-mobs
scenes.description: Two zombies, a skeleton and a pig pinned with --still-mobs and held alight with --burning (capture-only), on stone at noon: Java's flame (`FlameFeatureRenderer`: camera-facing fire quads over each mob's box) on burning mobs (v1.0 gap Track 8d; before it, rising cubes and an orange tint). Without --burning, as on older commits, the same mobs stand unlit

scenes.name: burning-player
scenes.description: A survival player standing in a fire on netherrack (which keeps it lit through a slow capture), on stone, at noon (`fire_damage` off, so a slow software capture can't kill them), seen in third person from behind: Java's flame over the player's box (v1.0 gap Track 8d; before it a burning player wasn't drawn on fire)
